Current Ph.D. Students

  • Iván Calvo: A specification language for the evaluation, orchestration, and fine-tuning of artificial intelligence models.
  • Freddy Batista: Developing a New Methodology to Estimate the Added Value of Public Schools in Colombia Using Spatial Data and Machine Learning (together with Borja Moya-Gómez).

Former Ph.D. Students

  • Natalia López: Semantics for Non-Markovian models
  • Ismael Rodríguez: PAMR: Syntax, semantics, and applications
  • Mercedes G. Merayo: Testing of temporal and probabilistic systems (together with Rob Hierons)
  • César Andrés: Active and passive testing of timed and probabilistic systems (together with Mercedes G. Merayo)
  • Carlos Molinero: Two applications of formal methods to the development and testing of complex systems
  • Alfredo Ibias: Applications of Information Theory and Artificial Intelligence to Software testing
  • Miguel Benito-Parejo: Using evolutive algorithms to optimise collaborative testing (together with Mercedes G. Merayo)
